question: Is same-day settlement approved for MYR accounts?

claims.text: Same-day settlement is approved for Singapore SGD pilot accounts; MYR accounts are outside this scope.

supports.quote: Same-day settlement is approved for Singapore SGD pilot accounts; MYR accounts are outside this scope.

claims.text: An unsigned draft saying MYR settlement is available is a proposal, not the approved operating rule.

supports.quote: An unsigned draft says MYR settlement is available; it is a proposal, not the approved operating rule.

uncertainties: Synthesized from current authorized evidence; exact supporting quotes and a separate model review were checked. Model review can miss errors; verify important conclusions.

evidence.title: settlement / Settlement scope
evidence.text:
[SYNTHETIC]
Same-day settlement is approved for Singapore SGD pilot accounts; MYR accounts are outside this scope.

evidence.title: reconciliation / Batch deadline
evidence.text:
[SYNTHETIC]
For Singapore weekday batches the deadline is 18:00 SGT; weekend batches have no same-day deadline.

evidence.title: settlement / Contradictory proposal
evidence.text:
[SYNTHETIC]
An unsigned draft says MYR settlement is available; it is a proposal, not the approved operating rule.

evidence.title: settlement / Future settlement schedule
evidence.text:
[SYNTHETIC]
The proposed November hourly schedule is not approved. Current settlement is daily.

evidence.title: integration / USD exception
evidence.text:
[SYNTHETIC]
Singapore business USD accounts require a separate connector approval; SGD approval does not include USD.

evidence.title: integration / SGD account eligibility
evidence.text:
[SYNTHETIC]
The Atlas connector supports Singapore business SGD accounts, not personal accounts.

Atlas account eligibility
Account	Scope

 Singapore business SGD 	 Pilot supported 

 Personal SGD 	 Not supported

evidence.title: settlement / Settlement dependency
evidence.text:

SET-610 is In Progress because bank confirmation is missing. Owner: Eva.

evidence.title: migration / Cutover ticket
evidence.text:
[SYNTHETIC]
MIG-301 is In Progress. Owner: Chen. The remaining blocker is unmatched settlement totals.

evidence.title: migration / Rollback signal
evidence.text:
[SYNTHETIC]
Roll back the ledger migration if settlement differences exceed five basis points.

evidence.title: settlement / Escalation guidance
evidence.text:
[SYNTHETIC]
If bank confirmation is absent, ask Eva for status; do not promise a completed settlement.

evidence.title: access / Approved public guidance
evidence.text:
[SYNTHETIC]
Partner users may read approved integration eligibility guidance; incident details are not public guidance.

evidence.title: webhook / External commitment
evidence.text:
[SYNTHETIC]
Webhook latency targets apply to the pilot only; no general customer latency guarantee is approved.

evidence.title: migration / Unapproved alternative
evidence.text:
[SYNTHETIC]
Dual-region active writes were proposed but not approved; the accepted migration uses one writer.

evidence.title: Payment-retry release approval
evidence.text:
[SYNTHETIC]
Release decision: controlled pilot approved. General availability (GA) not approved. PAY-102 Done is not customer release approval.

evidence.title: Payment-retry capability
evidence.text:
[SYNTHETIC]
Payment-retry is available only to the controlled pilot. General availability (GA) is not approved. No general release date is confirmed.

evidence.title: Operations readiness
evidence.text:
[SYNTHETIC]
Describe payment-retry only within the approved pilot scope. Unconfirmed items: general availability date and expansion beyond pilot customers.
